clients_retention_hold_check.name: clients_retention_hold_check
clients_retention_hold_check.value: ("studio"."clients"."retention_hold" and "studio"."clients"."retention_hold_reason" is not null and "studio"."clients"."retention_hold_reason" in ('contract','payment','dispute','other_business_need')) or (not "studio"."clients"."retention_hold" and "studio"."clients"."retention_hold_reason" is null)

contacts_client_email_uq.name: contacts_client_email_uq
contacts_client_email_uq.where: "studio"."contacts"."email" is not null and "studio"."contacts"."archived_at" is null

contacts_retention_hold_check.name: contacts_retention_hold_check
contacts_retention_hold_check.value: ("studio"."contacts"."retention_hold" and "studio"."contacts"."retention_hold_reason" is not null and "studio"."contacts"."retention_hold_reason" in ('contract','payment','dispute','other_business_need')) or (not "studio"."contacts"."retention_hold" and "studio"."contacts"."retention_hold_reason" is null)

contracts_end_after_start.name: contracts_end_after_start
contracts_end_after_start.value: "studio"."contracts"."end_date" is null or "studio"."contracts"."start_date" is null or "studio"."contracts"."end_date" >= "studio"."contracts"."start_date"

inquiries_fields_check.name: inquiries_fields_check
inquiries_fields_check.value: length(trim("studio"."inquiries"."name")) between 1 and 200 and length("studio"."inquiries"."email") between 1 and 320 and "studio"."inquiries"."email"=lower("studio"."inquiries"."email") and length(trim("studio"."inquiries"."description")) between 20 and 5000 and ("studio"."inquiries"."company" is null or length("studio"."inquiries"."company") <= 200) and ("studio"."inquiries"."budget" is null or length("studio"."inquiries"."budget") <= 200)

projects_target_end_after_start.name: projects_target_end_after_start
projects_target_end_after_start.value: "studio"."projects"."target_end_date" is null or "studio"."projects"."start_date" is null or "studio"."projects"."target_end_date" >= "studio"."projects"."start_date"

projects_actual_end_after_start.name: projects_actual_end_after_start
projects_actual_end_after_start.value: "studio"."projects"."actual_end_date" is null or "studio"."projects"."start_date" is null or "studio"."projects"."actual_end_date" >= "studio"."projects"."start_date"

retention_events_reason_check.name: retention_events_reason_check
retention_events_reason_check.value: ("studio"."retention_events"."action"='remove' and "studio"."retention_events"."reason" is null) or ("studio"."retention_events"."action" in ('hold_set','hold_release') and "studio"."retention_events"."reason" is not null and "studio"."retention_events"."reason" in ('contract','payment','dispute','other_business_need'))

retention_events_counts_check.name: retention_events_counts_check
retention_events_counts_check.value: jsonb_typeof("studio"."retention_events"."counts")='object' and "studio"."retention_events"."counts" ?& array['clients','contacts','notes'] and ("studio"."retention_events"."counts" - 'clients' - 'contacts' - 'notes')='{}'::jsonb and ("studio"."retention_events"."counts"->>'clients') ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$' and ("studio"."retention_events"."counts"->>'contacts') ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$' and ("studio"."retention_events"."counts"->>'notes') ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$' and ("studio"."retention_events"."action"='remove' or "studio"."retention_events"."counts"='{"clients":0,"contacts":0,"notes":0}'::jsonb)
